settings.headline: I'm June. I draw every line.
settings.subtitle: June Calloway, AIA (fictional) — solo architect in Marfa, Texas. Rammed earth, deep shade, small houses that hold their temperature.

settings.headline: Why Marfa, why earth
settings.body:
I came to west Texas to build a house for my sister and stayed because the material was already here: caliche and clay that, rammed in lifts, make a wall that is cool at 4 pm and quiet in a windstorm. I apprenticed with an earth builder in New Mexico (in this story), got licensed, and started taking one or two houses at a time.

I live in a 1,100 sq ft rammed-earth house I drew in 2019. Its west wall is 18 inches thick and has no window. That decision teaches clients more than any rendering.

I work with two builders and one structural engineer, repeatedly, on purpose. You will meet them before you sign anything.
